session.title: Aside CLI release and session syntax verification

assistantAnswers.text:
## Session-continuation audit

The developer page shows <citation refs="DTTQABsoX-pPyu4_Z4V0j">`aside --session <session-id> "Continue"`</citation>.

Original URL: https://docs.aside.com/help/developers

The caller-observed installed **1.26.1008.1938** help instead shows:

`aside session resume <id> [prompt...]`

These are different command forms for the same stated purpose. The retrieved public page has **no explicit release-version marker or publication/update date**; it cannot be assigned specifically to 1.26.1008.1938.

**Still unverified:** whether the installed CLI accepts the public `--session` form as an alias, whether both forms behave equivalently, and whether either succeeds at runtime. No continuation command was executed, and local help remains caller-supplied evidence.

**Audit result:** public evidence **confirms the syntax discrepancy but narrows the original “documentation drift” conclusion**. It establishes a difference between public documentation and reported current help, not incompatibility, removal, or deprecation of the public syntax.
